hat.definition: A covering worn on the head for warmth, protection, or style.

cap.definition: A close-fitting hat, often with a peak at the front.

beanie.definition: A close-fitting soft hat, usually made of knitted fabric.

beret.definition: A cap with no brim or bill.

headband.definition: A band worn around or over the head.

hair-clip.definition: A small object used to hold hair in place or keep it away from the face.
hair-clip.exampleUsage: She used a hair clip to keep her hair away from her eyes.

tiara.definition: A jeweled headdress worn by women on formal occasions.

turban.definition: A head covering made by wrapping a long piece of fabric around the head.

visor.definition: A brim that projects to the front to shade the eyes.

fedora.definition: A hat made of felt with a creased crown.

necklace.definition: Jewelry consisting of a cord or chain (often bearing gems) worn about the neck as an ornament (especially by women).

pendant.definition: An adornment that hangs from a piece of jewelry (necklace or earring).

choker.definition: A necklace that fits closely around the neck.

chain.definition: A series of linked metal loops worn as jewelry.

bracelet.definition: A decorative band worn around the wrist.

bangle.definition: Jewelry worn around the wrist for decoration.

watch.definition: A small device worn or carried to tell the time.

wristband.definition: A band worn around the wrist to show admission or permission.

cuff.definition: A wide bracelet, often open on one side.

charm-bracelet.definition: A bracelet or chain worn around the wrist with small decorative objects attached to it.
charm-bracelet.exampleUsage: She added a tiny star to her charm bracelet.

ring.definition: A small circular piece of jewelry worn on a finger.

engagement-ring.definition: A ring given to a romantic partner and worn to show that the couple intends to marry.

wedding-band.definition: A ring worn to show that someone is married.

signet-ring.definition: A ring engraved with a distinctive design used to stamp wax or mark documents.

stud.definition: A small earring that sits close to the earlobe.

dangle-earring.definition: An earring that hangs below the earlobe and can move or swing freely.
dangle-earring.exampleUsage: Her dangle earring moved gently as she turned her head.

ear-cuff.definition: A small piece of jewelry that grips or wraps around the outer ear, often without needing a piercing.
ear-cuff.exampleUsage: She wore a silver ear cuff on the upper part of her ear.

piercing.definition: A small hole made in the body for wearing jewelry.
piercing.exampleUsage: The piercing was used during the activity.

handbag.definition: A container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women).

tote-bag.definition: A roomy bag designed to carry a substantial number of items.

messenger-bag.definition: A bag with a long strap that is usually worn across the body and rests at the side or hip.
messenger-bag.exampleUsage: He carried his laptop in a messenger bag.

clutch.definition: A small bag carried in the hand, often at formal events.

wallet.definition: A pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money.

purse.definition: A container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women).

briefcase.definition: A flat case with a handle for carrying documents or a laptop.

duffel-bag.definition: A large, round bag made from tough fabric carries personal items or equipment and closes with a drawstring or zipper.

fanny-pack.definition: A small bag worn on a strap around the waist.

sunglasses.definition: (plural) spectacles that are darkened or polarized to protect the eyes from the glare of the sun.

scarf.definition: A long piece of fabric worn around the neck for warmth or style.

gloves.definition: Coverings worn on the hands for warmth or protection.

belt.definition: A band to tie or buckle around the body (usually at the waist).

umbrella.definition: A covering used to protect someone from rain.

tie-pin.definition: A small decorative pin used to secure or decorate a necktie.
tie-pin.exampleUsage: He wore a simple silver tie pin with his suit.

brooch.definition: A decorative pin worn by women.

pocket-watch.definition: A small watch carried in a pocket, often attached to a chain.

cane.definition: A stick used for support when walking.
